title: The rwb-agent tool call, per-item field names and unavailable-read mapping behind RWB-P10-E2030-CON
source: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 16 and 42; FSD P5 Document hub v3; TSD P5 Document hub v2; legacy RWB-E2-030
section: Preconditions; Flow; Acceptance criteria AC1 and AC4; Contract 12.2 and 12.8
description: RWB-P10-E2030-CON is the only contract this slice consumes, and no source names the operation by which the legal document agent reads the pack evidence, the per-item field names it expects, the item codes of output schema legal-pack-v1, or the exact status and fallback mapping a 503 of the document service produces on the agent run. The legacy story fixes only the run status TOOL_UNAVAILABLE with fallback true and R-UNI-33.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-030 flow step 2 names 'the checklist for the case type' and AC6 names 'the P5 document interface is unavailable'; TSD P5 T-A.2 gives API-P5-008 a response named DocumentChecklist only, and Architecture v5 slide 16 gives the agent contract no field list.
proposed: RWB-P10-E2030-CON publishes the pack tool call as one operation per case with named per-item fields and a stated mapping of 503 to TOOL_UNAVAILABLE with fallback true, so rwb-document builds against a shape rather than a guess.

title: The checklist is keyed by stage and route while the legacy asks for the checklist of a case type
source: TSD P5 Document hub v2 T3.1 document_checklist_item and T3.2 LOV-STAGE and LOV-ROUTE; FSD P5 Document hub v3 A2.16; legacy RWB-E2-030 Background
section: Preconditions; Flow; Acceptance criteria AC1 and AC3; Solution plan
description: document_checklist_item carries stage_code and route_code and no case type, while legacy RWB-E2-030 asks for the checklist of case type MORTGAGE_CIVIL with 9 items. No source gives a case-type key, a case-type to stage and route mapping, or the 9 items of that case type, so the version in force that the pack evidence must use cannot be resolved character for character.
evidence: TSD P5 T3.1 document_checklist_item: stage_code LOV-STAGE, route_code LOV-ROUTE, document_type LOV-DOC-TYPE, with no case-type column; legacy RWB-E2-030 Background names case type MORTGAGE_CIVIL and 9 items; FSD P5 AC-P5-016-01 uses stage LITIGATION with 4 items.
proposed: State the case type to stage and route mapping in the FSD P5 A2.16 section, or add the case type as a key of the checklist, and load the litigation pack checklist of 9 items at a named version.

title: The per-item fields of the document checklist answer the pack reader needs
source: TSD P5 Document hub v2 Appendix T-A.2 API-P5-008; FSD P5 Document hub v3 A2.16; TSD P5 T3.1
description: The API-P5-008 response is named DocumentChecklist and described as 'the required document types for the case with present counts' only; no source names the per-item field list, whether an item carries the document IDs held against it, whether the completeness record is returned with its event reference, or how a page of items is bounded.
evidence: TSD P5 T-A.2 API-P5-008 response 'DocumentChecklist', request 'None'; legacy RWB-E2-030 AC1 requires 'a pack listing document IDs for each of the 9 items', a shape the hub contract does not name.
proposed: Fix the DocumentChecklist schema in the Service Contract Catalog with the per-item fields, the document list per item and the completeness reference, so the answer is asserted field for field.

title: The defect status of a checklist item and the evidence it needs on the hub side
source: TSD P5 Document hub v2 T3.1 case_document_check; FSD P5 Document hub v3 A2.16; legacy RWB-E2-030 BR3
section: Story; Acceptance criteria AC1; Solution plan; Out of scope
description: case_document_check holds required_count, present_count, missing_types, complete and checked_at and no defect concept, while legacy RWB-E2-030 requires every item to carry PRESENT, MISSING or DEFECT with a reason. No source says whether the hub records a defect, which document field or review status evidences it, or who decides it.
evidence: TSD P5 T3.1 case_document_check DF-DOC-036 to DF-DOC-044; legacy RWB-E2-030 BR3 'every item has a status PRESENT, MISSING or DEFECT, and every DEFECT has a reason' and AC5 'An item without a status'.
proposed: Decide whether the hub owns the defect mark or leaves it to the agent, and if the hub owns it, name the evidence in case_document_check and the field of document_field it reads.

title: The BRD section and L3 process of REQ-DCM-011
source: FSD P5 Document hub v3 A2.16 and requirement table; legacy RWB-E2-030 section 18
description: The requirement statement of REQ-DCM-011 is in the FSD P5 requirement table with its priority and its epic, but no source names the BRD section or the L3 process it belongs to. The legacy story cites the Business Requirements Program section 5.11 and L3 process 8.2 for REQ-S4-002, which is a different requirement.
evidence: FSD P5 requirement table row REQ-DCM-011 'A document checklist per case type is held as reference data so that a missing document is visible. | Must | E1'; legacy RWB-E2-030 section 18 gives section 5.11 and process 8.2 for REQ-S4-002 only.
proposed: Name the BRD section and the L3 process of REQ-DCM-011 in the next BRD version so the traceability row can be completed.
